arguments.message: You can confirm whether the issue you’re seeing was a known incident by checking Meridian’s status page. The page lists all incidents—including brief ones—with start and end times and shows which components (API, dashboard, etc.) were affected. It also retains a history, so you can look at earlier windows in the day if needed. If the incident appears there, it’s a platform‑wide event; if not, it’s likely a local issue.
